Explanation:  
The ground truth answer states that the 1975 winner of the Lenore Marshall Poetry Prize would have been 90 years old on the release date of "Milk and Honey" by Rupi Kaur. The predicted answer, however, identifies the winner as Stanley Kunitz (born July 29, 1905), and states he would have been 109 years old on November 4, 2014 (the book's release). The predicted answer provides a different age (109) rather than the ground truth age (90) and even presents reasoning that leads to this different answer.
